x: Henry Martin managed to dodge all offers to join the Army and scored a triple win in the 100, 220 and 440. George Davidson ran sensibly to win the 1 mile and some anonymous vocal support spurred Dave Hooper into 2nd place.
Herne Hill's Rawe took the quarter from H. Martin and a very close team event over 2 miles gave Herne Hill a one point win over us, Len Bishop being 2nd to Towl.

Henry Martin produced a promising early season effort in the quarter when running a close second to Woodland of Hercules(52.0) and, although only placed fifth, it was good to see Jim Heathfield running quarters once more after his third retirement from the event!

Gerry Leroy and Henry Martin finished first and second in the 440 yds with 51.7 and 52.0s. respectively, although Gerry was rather disappointed with his performance, being hampered in training by a recurrent leg injury.
Derek had earlier had a battle royal with the 'Vicar of Bray' of athletics, Henry Martin. Our 'enry just held on to win in 53.8 to 53.9 in the quarter.
